conformance_summary.certification_disclaimer: Synthetic in-process fixtures only. C13/E28 and the selected upstream conformance suite remain unqualified. DO NOT claim official CNCF Certified Kubernetes qualification or multi-node certification.

exclusions.rationale: Tests tagged [Serial] serialize the entire test run and take multiple hours, exceeding CI budget. Synthetic in-process domain tests exercise concurrency; no live single-node concurrency is qualified.
Disruptive tests intentionally cordon, drain, or reboot the node, which terminates the single control plane / worker host in single-node topologies.
Tests tagged [Slow] test multi-hour soaking and extreme replica counts (1000+ pods) that exceed single-node edge footprints.
Upstream tests identified as flaky are excluded to prevent non-deterministic failure reporting in automated qualification gates.
Rubix is an architectural single-node Kubernetes distribution using NodeSetter admission; multi-node scheduling topologies are not applicable.
Multi-node scheduling, cross-node pod anti-affinity, and node failover are out of scope for single-node Rubix clusters.
Workload distribution across multiple physical hosts requires a full cluster topology, inapplicable to single-node architecture.
